verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party way to export a Make project's code, backend data, or files in open formats so a user can leave. The docs only say the code lives inside the Make project, where it can be viewed and edited, and that previews can be copied as layers into Figma Design, which keeps the work inside Figma. Community reports go further: Figma's API rejects .make files, and users had to reverse-engineer an undocumented binary format to extract their React apps and migrate away. That is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
